combat_classes.line_combat: Eligible for normal assault/contact according to position and technique range.
combat_classes.combat_support: Primary value is reconnaissance, barriers, engineering, sensors, couriers or other specialist support. No automatic assault frontage; may fight when ordered/exposed using its own unit stats.
combat_classes.service_support: Communications and logistics are targetable military support units. They do not add default assault frontage; self-defense or deliberate commitment resolves from their own saved capability.
combat_classes.noncombat_support: Training/civilian/noncombat personnel do not become combatants without a lawful conversion/mobilization transaction.

capacities.medical_nin: treatment_capacity = fit medical personnel x current medical skill/control x usable supplies/facility x available treatment time; treatment changes real injury outcomes but never erases anatomy or elapsed time.
capacities.sensor_information: information_capacity = fit sensor/recon personnel x relevant sensing/scouting capability x coverage geometry x communication quality x elapsed observation time.
capacities.communications: relay_capacity and order delay depend on fit communicators, range/path, equipment/techniques, interference and commander load.
capacities.logistics: throughput depends on fit support personnel, transport, route, available stores, handling time and security.

named_exception: Named combat medics/sensors resolve from their exact sheets. Their specialty role never deletes their real combat ability.
casualty_rule: Support casualties reduce the corresponding support capacity immediately and persist like all other casualties.
